violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: fried wings (123-132f) were stored on prep table for about 40 minutes.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed the CFM to discard the wings in no more than 3 hours. CFM has requested the use of TPHC moving forward.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: - OBSERVED: frozen chicken was thawing on the drain board of 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed the CFM that frozen foods shall be thawed inside a refrigerator overnight or in only food prep sink under running water (at no more than a temperature of 70f).

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: (1) SHREDDED CHEDDAR CHEESE (50F) AND COOKED ONION (72F) WERE STORED IN WELLS COLD WELL FOR 4 HOURS; (2) SHREDDED LETTUCE (49F) AND SLICED TOMATO (41F) WERE STORED IN 2-DOOR PREP COOLER FOR 5 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): CHICKEN CALIFORNIA.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS AND CFM SIGNED THE TPHC AGREEMENT.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: SHREDDED LETTUCE WAS FULLY PACKED IN A PLASTIC CONTAINER WITH ITS LID TIGHTLY COVERED. THE SHREDDED LETTUCE WAS STORED IN 2-DOOR PREP COOLER AND FAILED TO COOL DOWN TO 41F WITHIN 5 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE CREATE AIR GAPS BETWEEN THE OUTLET OF 3-COMPARTMENT SINK AND FLOOR DRAIN.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. HAND SINK AT SERVICE LINE WAS USED TO STORE A WHETSTONE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM REMOVED THE WHETSTONE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF CHEESE WHEEZ SAUCE, BUFFALO SAUCE, TERIYAKI SAUCE, AND BBQ SAUCE WERE NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELED THE SQUEEZE BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. LIVE FLIES WERE OBSERVED IN THE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 2-DOOR PREP COOLER WAS 50F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNIT. TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURE WILL BE USED FOR FOOD STORED IN THIS UNIT.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: CHEMICAL DISPENSER AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK IS LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used ONLY for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS recommended storing the spatulas in hot water on the grill to assist with cleaning.

violations.title: Sanitizer Solution Stored off floor; No Food Contamination
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloth buckets improperly stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloth buckets containing chemical sanitizing solutions shall not be stored on the floor. The wet towel buckets shall also be used in a manner that prevents contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC will obtain wiping cloth bucket stands, hangers, or wall-mounts.
